implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired confirmatory run (scenario_recommended_200) using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter. Use the adapter's deterministic task_index_profile (challenging_workflow_stress_v1) to select the 200 task indices listed above prior to any model calls. For each task index run two episodes (baseline: one-shot LLM generation; guarded: LLM generation → deterministic verifier → at most one LLM repair → verifier re-check). Orchestrate simulation and deterministic scoring in CPU-based Docker containers; no human labour or external/private resources. Log all model I/O, verifier logs, simulator traces, hashes, and execution metadata for reproducibility.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic selection via adapter 'challenging_workflow_stress_v1' profile; selection fixed and recorded prior to model calls; excluded/exploratory items logged per contamination_plan.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Use transformation families direct_configuration_generation_v1 and generate_validate_repair_v1 as provided by adapter; verifier and automatic rejection rules per preregistration/transformation_validation.
execution_batches: batch_1_confirmatory_all_tasks (200 paired intents; total planned model calls = 400)
randomisation_plan: No randomisation for task selection (adapter-determined deterministic profile). Within automated audit sampling, use pseudorandom generator with recorded seed for 10% audit sample selection.
caching_plan: Cache and deduplicate identical LLM requests/responses where adapter permits; store SHA256 of inputs/outputs. Do not reuse cached outputs across conditions for the same intent.
failure_recovery_plan: Follow frozen retry policy: allow infrastructure restarts only for genuine infra failures (logged). On provider API transient failures, retry once per call within adapter-enforced model-call budget; record failure reason and treat according to missingness_plan.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (per-episode machine-readable record: intent_id, task_index, condition, model_inputs, model_outputs, verifier_log, simulator_trace, binary_label_safe, hashes, timestamps)
estimated_compute_notes: Planned model calls=400 (one initial generation + up to one repair per task). Hosted API calls within capability manifest (max 10000). CPU-based Dockerized Mininet simulations run in parallel batches; wall-clock within 7 days.
